alternate_sampling_audit.evaluator: alternate sampler seed against fixed primary real descriptor reference
alternate_sampling_audit.reference_note: Real descriptor rows are fixed to the primary seed-2026 audit so the alternate run changes only sampling randomness.

claim_boundary: A BASE train-only image/distribution audit passed its predeclared broad gate.
The corrected generic-core distance was 7.681 times the real split-half p90 reference, so fidelity is not close to real-data variability.
No physics-constrained or downstream forecasting conclusion is supported by this run.
The local resume did not restore optimizer or RNG state because numbered checkpoints did not contain them.

destruction_controls.interpretation: A control is useful only if it changes its targeted descriptor while preserving nuisance descriptors sufficiently; these controls are diagnostic and are not downstream evidence.
destruction_controls.purpose: counterfactual generated-field destruction controls; no forecasting outputs

limitations: The upper-latitude band has very few rows and should not be overinterpreted.
These are descriptive train-only diagnostics and do not modify the frozen generic gate.
Conditional proxy agreement would not establish physical realism or forecasting utility.
conditional_proxy_diagnostics.method: fixed latitude bands with independent connected-region bootstrap of medians

limitations: This is uncertainty around the finite train-only audit sample, not a probability that the generator is scientifically valid.
It resamples the completed 128 synthetic outputs and does not add new model samples.
It does not inspect validation/test outcomes or alter the frozen gate definition.
gate_stability_diagnostics.method: connected-region bootstrap with replacement; corrected five-criterion BASE gate

limitations: Nearest-neighbor distance is a low-dimensional similarity check, not proof of non-memorization or physical realism.
The synthetic sample is conditioned on label and latitude; same-source comparisons are descriptive and may reflect shared conditioning strata.
No validation/test flare outcomes are accessed and no model gate is changed.
memorization_diagnostics.method: 16x16 pooled asinh field-space nearest-neighbor and exact-hash audit

offline_protocol_selftests.interpretation: These are offline infrastructure and protocol checks. They validate acquisition, cache, time-repair, and downstream-policy primitives; they are not additional training, forecasting, or physical-transfer results.

interpretation: All three screen arms activated their intended differentiable physics loss.
All three screen arms failed the broad corrected generic gate at 100 steps; this is an early-training diagnostic, not evidence that a full arm cannot converge.
No downstream forecasting or test-set selection was performed from these screens.
physics_factorial_screening.screen_type: 100-step positive-only fine-tune from frozen BASE EMA; exploratory, not confirmatory

limitations: A high AUC shows distinguishability, not which distribution is scientifically preferable.
The classifier is a low-dimensional/coarse-field probe and cannot replace the declared independent descriptors.
This audit uses the positive training cache and does not access validation/test outcomes.
two_sample_classifier_audit.method: five-fold StratifiedGroupKFold logistic classifier; group-held-out and independent of forecast outcomes
two_sample_classifier_audit.shared_grouping_note: Real and generated records use the same connected-region ID when the synthetic sample was conditioned on that region; this is conservative against region memorization.

experiment: IRIS BASE local resume and independent v2 audit

independent_audit.evaluator: v2 independent hard thresholds; corrected generic-core distance
independent_audit.generic_distance_correction_reason: real saturation has near-zero dispersion, causing pathological robust standardisation; absolute saturation gate remains unchanged

resume_config.note: Resumed from a numbered model checkpoint; original optimizer/RNG state was not stored.

frozen_split.method: connected HARP-NOAA groups, exact JSOC TAI converted to UTC, chronology 60/20/20, 36h buffer
